paper_title: Searches for electron interactions induced by new physics in the EDELWEISS-III germanium bolometers
notes: EDELWEISS-III Ge bolometers. Multiple results: solar axion CBRD gives g_ae < 1.1e-11 (90% CL) in massless limit (encoded here as a mass-independent horizontal line valid up to ~keV solar temperature). Also g_ae x g_aN^eff < 3.5e-17 (AxionNeutron/Proton product, not encoded), and mass-dependent bosonic DM absorption limits on g_ae (ALP) and kinetic mixing kappa (hidden photon) over 0.8-500 keV shown only in Figures 3-5 (no numerical table available, so those plot curves could not be extracted precisely). DM density rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed for the halo absorption searches. Projections down to 150 eV also presented but the emitted number is the observed solar limit, not a projection. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.6, 2))
